title: Richard A. Oh
text: Hi! My name is Richard, and I am a fourth-year undergraduate studying mathematics at Stanford University. I am interested in the intersection between topology and probability—in particular, how the notion of randomness might offer new perspectives on topology through probabilistic methods. Currently, I am curious about how the rich algebraic machinery associated with topology might serve as a bridge between these seemingly distant branches of mathematics.

title: Probabilistic Topology Playground
text: This page contains exploratory ideas, unfinished investigations, reading notes, and possible directions related to the intersection of probability and topology.
